Copilot Cowork cost tip #6:
Use /cost on every new session.

If you're a Frontier customer with the grace period until July 1, this is your training window.

Don't waste it.

Run real tasks.

Then type:
/cost

You'll see the exact Copilot Credits used for that task so far.

Do this for drafts, decks, research, browser tasks, file analysis, and heavy artifacts.

Different work burns different credits.

Tell every Copilot Cowork user in your tenant to build this habit NOW.

Don't wait for the bill to teach you what /cost could have shown you today.
